summary: Trump announced a historic Peace Council agreement for the complete disarmament of Hamas and all armed groups in Gaza, with Israeli withdrawal and an international stabilization force. The IDF eliminated a senior Kataib al-Mujahideen commander involved in the October 7 kidnappings in a precise airstrike in southern Gaza. Iran launched suicide drones at a Kuwaiti base hosting U.S. forces, which Kuwait intercepted, while the U.S. and Israel reportedly review a land blockade plan against Iran.
key_points: Trump announced a Peace Council agreement for full disarmament of Hamas and all armed groups in Gaza, Israeli withdrawal, and an international stabilization force with a new Palestinian police force. (Source: @almogboker78/17858)

IDF eliminated Ahmed Hussein Muhammad Kafina, commander of Central Camps in Kataib al-Mujahideen, who participated in the October 7 kidnappings of Avintan Or, Noa Argamani, and directed the kidnapping of Sudisak Rintalak. (Source: @idf_telegram/24787)

IDF demolished a massive tunnel in the southern Ali Taher ridge near Beaufort using 700 tons of explosives placed by the Yahalom unit, destroying most of the tunnel network in the area. (Source: @inon_yttach/9766)
The U.S. and Israel are reviewing a land blockade plan for Iran to increase economic pressure by closing border crossings via neighboring countries. (Source: @mamlekate/104051)

Iran attacked the Ahmad al-Jaber base in Kuwait hosting U.S. forces with suicide drones; Kuwaiti air defenses intercepted several drones, debris caused material damage, no casualties. (Source: @VahidOnline/77672)

IDF arrested over 200 wanted Palestinians in the West Bank during the past week, seized weapons-manufacturing items, firearms, a drone, tens of thousands of shekels for terror, and destroyed five explosive devices. (Source: @idf_telegram/24789)

Israeli civilians entered the outskirts of Nablus, clashed with Palestinians, vandalized a cemetery; IDF dispersed them and later shot at a main inciter during stone-throwing at forces. (Source: @inon_yttach/9771)

The Givati Brigade's Tzabar battalion was disbanded after 17 soldiers were jailed for 30 days and three more face similar punishment; commanders lost trust of all fighters. (Source: @New_security8200/203111)

sections.executive_summary: Trump announced a historic Peace Council agreement for the complete disarmament of Hamas and all armed groups in Gaza, with Israeli forces to withdraw and an international stabilization force to assume security alongside a new Palestinian police force. The IDF eliminated a senior Kataib al-Mujahideen commander in southern Gaza who directly participated in the October 7 kidnappings of three hostages. Iran launched suicide drones at a Kuwaiti base hosting U.S. forces, prompting Kuwaiti interceptions and debris damage, while the U.S. and Israel reportedly examine a land blockade strategy to strangle Iran's economy.

points: The U.S. and Israel are reviewing a land blockade plan for Iran aimed at increasing economic pressure by closing or restricting border crossings through neighboring countries to target Iran's imports and exports. (Source: @mamlekate/104051)

Iran's Revolutionary Guard launched suicide drones at the Ahmad al-Jaber base in Kuwait, which hosts U.S. forces; Kuwaiti air defenses identified and destroyed several hostile drones, with falling debris causing material damage but no human casualties. (Source: @VahidOnline/77672)
Iran announced the closure of its entire southern coastline for two months, prohibiting any approach for recreation or fishing, placing the area under military control. (Source: @kianmeli1/90375)

U.S. Central Command refuted IRGC claims, stating no U.S. aircraft were destroyed in recent Iranian attacks — all missiles and drones were intercepted or failed — and that over 20 warships continue to enforce a maritime blockade, which the tanker M/T Nora has not broken. (Source: @shin_persian/8737)

Iranian journalist Mehrdad Khalili noted that since 2009 Iran has supplied Palestinian resistance in Gaza across 2,000 km despite a total air, land, and sea blockade, and has not abandoned its allies in Yemen despite ongoing blockade, suggesting Iran has experience in breaking blockades. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382251)

Hamzeh Safavi dismissed the argument that Iran's 60% enriched uranium stockpile deters a nuclear attack, calling it a fallacy and questioning why the same logic would not imply the uranium stockpile invites attack. (Source: @SharghDaily/175457)

Trump announced a Peace Council historic agreement for the complete disarmament of Hamas and all other armed groups in Gaza; Israeli forces will withdraw upon completion, and an international stabilization force will work with a new Palestinian police force to secure Gaza, with the threat of October 7 not allowed to rebuild. (Source: @almogboker78/17858, @inon_yttach/9768)

The IDF eliminated Ahmed Hussein Muhammad Kafina, commander of the Central Camps area in Kataib al-Mujahideen, who led and directed the October 7 raid into Israel and participated in the kidnappings of Avintan Or, Noa Argamani, and the kidnapping of Sudisak Rintalak; he was killed in a precise airstrike in southern Gaza earlier this week. (Source: @idf_telegram/24787)

The IDF demolished a massive tunnel in the southern part of the Ali Taher ridge near Beaufort using 700 tons of explosives placed by the Yahalom unit over several weeks, destroying most of the tunnel network in the area; the IDF continues to monitor a major Hezbollah tunnel system beneath the Ali Taher ridge where dozens of operatives are believed to be holed up. (Source: @inon_yttach/9766, @manniefabian/58898)

During the past week, IDF forces conducted dozens of offensive counterterrorism operations in Judea and Samaria, arresting over 200 wanted individuals including Hamas affiliates, an imminent attack planner, arms dealers, and explosives manufacturers; they seized dozens of weapons-manufacturing items, airsoft guns, hunting rifles, a pistol, a drone, tens of thousands of shekels designated for terror, and destroyed five explosive devices. (Source: @idf_telegram/24789)

Israeli civilians entered the outskirts of Nablus in the Samaria Brigade; Palestinians threw stones, one Israeli fired in the air, and vandalism of a cemetery was reported; pre-positioned IDF forces dispersed the gathering and removed all civilians, later responding to stone-throwing at forces with an arrest procedure that included shooting at a main inciter. (Source: @inon_yttach/9771)

The Givati Brigade's Tzabar battalion, described as the IDF's outstanding infantry battalion, was disbanded due to severe leadership failures by its commander; 17 soldiers were sentenced to 30 days in prison and removed from combat, three more face similar punishment, and the entire battalion was confined to base for Shabbat, leaving 0% of fighters trusting their commanders in combat. (Source: @New_security8200/203111)

National Security Minister Ben-Gvir rejected the Peace Council's draft agreement as unacceptable, stating that after October 7 the blood of every Hamas member is forfeit, and that ceasing assassinations would allow Hamas to reorganize for the next massacre; he vowed assassinations in Gaza must continue and emigration should be encouraged. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86536)

The Peace Council agreement stipulates full disarmament of Hamas and all armed groups in Gaza, Israeli withdrawal, and an international stabilization force working with a new Palestinian police force to assume security responsibility, with Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey thanked as mediators. (Source: @almogboker78/17858, @inon_yttach/9768)

The IDF eliminated Ahmed Hussein Muhammad Kafina, a senior Kataib al-Mujahideen commander in southern Gaza, who participated in the October 7 kidnappings and directed terror operations against IDF forces and Israeli civilians. (Source: @idf_telegram/24787)

IDF West Bank operations over the past week resulted in over 200 arrests of wanted Palestinians, including Hamas operatives, an imminent attack planner, arms smugglers, and explosives manufacturers; forces seized weapons-manufacturing materials, firearms, a drone, tens of thousands of shekels for terror, and destroyed five explosive devices, while mapping two terrorists' homes for demolition. (Source: @idf_telegram/24789)

Israeli civilians entered the outskirts of Nablus, leading to stone-throwing, an Israeli firing in the air, and cemetery vandalism; IDF forces dispersed the group and removed them, later engaging stone-throwers with live fire at a main inciter. (Source: @inon_yttach/9771)

A Palestinian attempted to seize the weapon of a security coordinator near Metzad in the Etzion Brigade; the coordinator shot the assailant in the leg and detained him, with no Israeli injuries. (Source: @idf_telegram/24786, @yediotnews25/133461)

A Hamas/Qassam statement declared that surrendering weapons is not a signed decision, not imposed, and not subject to discussion; it is a doctrine of survival, a right that cannot be taken, and a red line written in blood. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382257)
Ben-Gvir insisted that assassinations in Gaza must continue and emigration must be encouraged, rejecting any pause that would allow Hamas to regroup for future attacks. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86536)
Artillery shelling was reported on the Shebaa area in Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/34091)

The IDF Northern Command announced a massive explosion would be heard in Lebanon overnight from Israeli forces' activity, advising Metula residents to open windows to prevent shattering. (Source: @inon_yttach/9765)

The IDF demolished several key underground routes in the Beaufort Ridge area; over several weeks troops secured the ridge, took control of and cleared underground infrastructure, and prepared it for destruction; a previous demolition on July 13 destroyed one tunnel part, and the latest demolition destroyed most of the tunnel network in the area. (Source: @manniefabian/58898)

The IDF blew up a massive tunnel in the southern Ali Taher ridge near Beaufort using 700 tons of explosives placed by the Yahalom unit, destroying most of the tunnel network; the IDF continues to monitor a major Hezbollah tunnel system beneath the Ali Taher ridge where dozens of operatives are believed to remain. (Source: @inon_yttach/9766)
Low-altitude warplane activity was observed over the Nineveh Plain in Iraq. (Source: @shin_persian/8744)

Kuwaiti armed forces identified and destroyed several hostile drones in Kuwaiti airspace early Friday; the Kuwait Defense Ministry spokesperson stated Iran's aggression targeted vital and military facilities, with debris causing material damage but no casualties. (Source: @VahidOnline/77672)

U.S. Central Command maintains over 20 warships enforcing a maritime blockade, stating the tanker M/T Nora has not broken the blockade and all Iranian missiles and drones were intercepted or failed. (Source: @shin_persian/8737)
Yemen reports explosions and smoke plumes in Sanaa, likely from Saudi airstrikes. (Source: @inon_yttach/9759)
Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey were thanked by Trump as mediators for their important efforts in achieving the Peace Council breakthrough on Gaza. (Source: @inon_yttach/9768)

Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain, and Egypt previously imposed a blockade on Qatar, a much smaller state than Iran, and were forced to back down after four years, acknowledging failure. (Source: @asafroz/52128)

key_developments: Trump announced a Peace Council historic agreement for complete disarmament of Hamas and all armed groups in Gaza; Israeli forces to withdraw; international stabilization force to work with new Palestinian police force; threat from Oct 7 not
